stories.title: School Food
stories.excerpt: School food it's not always the topic of discussion, but it's very important to learn about what schools are feeding our students. In this article it will discuss how school food is now. How it is outside and inside TLC, how nutritious it is, and how the students of TLC can benefit from it.

stories.title: Artificial Intelligence. Is it bad to use?
stories.excerpt: Does AI deserve a chance? What good and bad can come from using it? And how could we be using it wisely? In this article we will discuss the basics of using AI.
